facts.F1:
[the customer] could not find where the SLE is shown. [the informant] looked on the Flow Metrics tab and did not see it until he found the toggle. Benjamin agreed: "where is it actually? We should have that somewhere."

The SLE is a goal, so the point is to see it next to how the Team actually performs, for example 72.7% of items within 10 days against a target of 70%.

Raised by [the customer]

- Make the SLE more prominent instead of hiding it behind chart toggles and a small header indicator.
- See how actual performance against the SLE develops over time. [the informant]: tracking this over time is key.
- Use wording like "or less" so it is clear to people new to flow.

Details to be worked out when we start on it.

(ADO Story #6563 description; customer and informant names replaced because customer identifiers are not committed. Maintainer's scope choice after DIVERGE, 2026-11-27: "Mix + daily record" - one new dedicated SLE widget in the overview, plus the SLE over time in Predictability as a persisted daily record.)
facts.F10: Then the widget's header trend indicator compares the share with the share in the preceding period of the same length, as the other Flow Overview widgets do; the widget body shows no change of its own.
facts.F100: Paradigm object_oriented: the backend is OO ports-and-adapters (CLAUDE.md); domain rules live on value objects in Modules/FlowMetrics/Domain, application services coordinate ports, frontend keeps its hook-and-pure-function style already used by ragRules*.ts.
facts.F101: Where the share is computed (Open, Design -> decided): the backend owns the share for both surfaces. New value object WithinSleShare (Modules/FlowMetrics/Domain/WithinSleShare.cs) is a closed choice NoSle | TooFew(closed) | Measured(within, closed, sle), built only by WithinSleShare.Of(cycleTimesInDays, sle). It is the one owner of the rule a Work Item is within when its Cycle Time is at or below the SLE days, and of the minimum of 5 (MinimumClosed). New value object ServiceLevelExpectation (Domain/ServiceLevelExpectation.cs; Percentile 1..100, Days >= 1) with For(WorkTrackingSystemOptionsOwner) returning null when either setting is 0 or less. The widget info and every daily record row go through WithinSleShare; the frontend never recounts.
facts.F102: S07b #6378 (BaseMetricsService to composition) is NOT a Before item: the share is not added to BaseMetricsService. New application services read closed cycle times through the existing ITeamMetricsService.GetCycleTimeDataForTeam and IPortfolioMetricsService.GetCycleTimeDataForPortfolio (default Cycle Time, cache and filters as the sibling widgets), so the base class gains no capability S07b would have to move.
facts.F103: Residual duplicate kept on purpose: calculateSLEStats in Lighthouse.Frontend/src/pages/Common/MetricsView/ragRulesTimeAndAge.ts still counts within-SLE for the Cycle Time Percentiles status, because the scope excludes any change to that widget and its status (Q7). Follow-up for the improvement backlog: move that status onto the backend share.
facts.F104: Read ports follow the S12a #6386 target shape, one query port per capability: IWithinSleInfoQuery (widget) and IWithinSleOverTimeSeriesQuery (chart) in Modules/FlowMetrics/Application, injected into TeamMetricsController and PortfolioMetricsController next to IPercentilesOverTimeSeriesQuery.
facts.F105: Widget read (S5): new GET teams/{id}/metrics/withinSleInfo and portfolios/{id}/metrics/withinSleInfo with startDate, endDate (inclusive days, inverted window -> 400 with the existing message). Answer WithinSleInfoDto(Verdict NoSle|TooFew|Measured, ClosedCount, WithinCount, SlePercentile?, SleDays?, SharePercent?, Comparison InfoWidgetComparisonDto) in its own file Models/Metrics/WithinSleInfoDto.cs; InfoWidgetDtos.cs is not touched.
facts.F106: Header trend (S6, Q2 previous-period): the comparison measures the preceding period of the same length exactly as cycleTimePercentilesInfo does (previousEnd = start - 1 day, previousStart = start - periodDays). Direction up/down by the sign of the share difference rounded to 0.1 points, flat at 0.0; delta text like +4.1 pts as sketched. The Proposed rule no comparison when either period is not Measured is adopted (direction none), because a share that is not judged (Q5) cannot be compared; it still awaits Product confirmation.
facts.F107: Status (S6, Q7) stays a frontend RAG rule like all sibling statuses (Signals is target only): extract statusAgainstTarget(sharePercent, targetPercent) from computeCycleTimePercentilesRag as the one owner of Sustain / Observe up to 20 points below / Act beyond, and add computeWithinSleRag(info, terms) that maps NoSle to Act and TooFew to no status. Cycle Time Percentiles output stays byte-identical.
facts.F108: Widget placement (Open, Design -> decided): widgetKey withinSle, size small, in flow-overview directly before percentiles (after predictabilityScore), no ownerFilter (Teams and Portfolios, Q6), trendPolicies withinSle previous-period, widgetFetchRequirements withinSle [withinSleInfo, cycleTimeData] because View Data reuses the Cycle Time Percentiles closed-items dialog fed by cycleTimeData. Title from terminology: Within {SLE}.
facts.F109: Loading and could-not-load looks (Open, Design -> decided): the widget takes WidgetShell status from useMetricsData fetchStates of the new fetch key withinSleInfo (useMetricsQuery, keyed by owner and selected window); the chart owns its fetch through a keyed TanStack query [owner id, ownerUpdatedAt, horizon, from, to] mapped to WidgetShell status by seriesStatusOf, so a late answer for an old horizon or range never lands and the previous answer is never shown as current.
facts.F110: Daily record (S7): new entity WithinSleSnapshot (Models/WithinSleSnapshot.cs, entities still sit in Models per ADR-270): Id, OwnerId, OwnerType, RecordedAt (DateOnly, named like the other snapshot tables), Horizon (30|60|90), ClosedCount, WithinCount, SlePercentile, SleDays, Origin (WithinSleSnapshotOrigin Recorded=0 | FilledIn=1). Unique index (OwnerId, OwnerType, Horizon, RecordedAt). Counts are stored, never a percentage; the share and verdict are derived on read by WithinSleShare. A row is written whenever an SLE is set, for any closed count including 0, so the tooltip can state the count; no row is written while no SLE is set.
facts.F111: Writer (S7): IWithinSleSnapshotWriter / WithinSleSnapshotWriter in Application, the single writer of WithinSleSnapshot rows, shaped like IPercentileSnapshotWriter: RecordToday overwrites today (row takes the SLE in force at the last recording of the day and Origin Recorded), FillDayIfAbsent never touches an existing row and writes Origin FilledIn against the SLE current at fill time (Q4), SaveFilledDay uses LostRaceTolerantSave. Family reader record WithinSleFamilyReader(ReadClosedCycleTimes(windowStart, windowEnd), CurrentSle()) in its own file.
facts.F112: Refresh events that record the day (Open, Design -> decided): TeamDataRefreshed and PortfolioFeaturesRefreshed, the same events as the percentile snapshots, through a new WithinSleRecordingHandler in Application/Policies with its own failure containment and alert family WithinSle. Registered in Program.cs beside ProcessBehaviorRecordingHandler, not in FlowMetricsModule: AddFlowMetrics runs before the handler block, so module registration would place it before TeamDataRefreshedTeamMetricsUpdateHandler and record stale metrics; DomainEventHandlerOrderPinTest pins the order. Cost accepted: the Program.cs edit runs the full backend Integration suite in S7.
facts.F113: Chart read (S7, Open -> decided): a new endpoint, not an extension of percentiles-over-time (different row shape; that endpoint already has external client consumers). GET teams/{id}/metrics/within-sle-over-time and portfolios/{id}/... with horizon 30|60|90 (anything else -> 400 naming the allowed values), optional startDate/endDate inclusive. Answer WithinSleOverTimeDto(CurrentSlePercentile?, CurrentSleDays?, Days WithinSleDayDto[]), each day RecordedAt, Horizon, ClosedCount, WithinCount, SlePercentile, SleDays, Origin, Verdict, SharePercent? so the frontend draws a point only where Verdict is Measured and never re-decides the minimum.
facts.F114: Fill-in (S8): OverTimeFillTarget gains WithinSleFamilies built beside the percentile families and guarded by a new RetentionEdge.Guard(WithinSleFamilyReader) overload; OverTimeHistoryFiller.FillOneDayAsync stages and saves the within-SLE family as a third TryWriteDayAsync, so one pass fills every chart of the owner. GapAskingWithinSleOverTimeSeriesQuery wraps the stored read and asks IOverTimeGapReconciler for missing days, registered in FlowMetricsModule like the percentile wrapper. No demo backfill handler: past days come from the filler when the chart opens.
facts.F115: Formal verification: claim each recorded day keeps its share and SLE; a fill never changes an existing day; a later row of a past day is always FilledIn; within never exceeds closed; no point below 5 -> Quint (state model over record, fill, SLE change and day advance), docs/feature/story-6563-sle-attainment/design/withinSleDailyRecord.qnt, checked by quint run per invariant and quint verify (Apalache, 6 steps). TLA+/TLC not needed: no fairness or temporal claim. Agda not needed: no type-level proof. Concurrency of two app copies is not modelled: the unique index plus LostRaceTolerantSave covers it and is observed by a SQLite service-port test like TwoCopiesFillingTheSameDayAtThePortTest. The share arithmetic (WithinSleShare.Of) is a pure function law checked by a default-suite property test, not by the model.
facts.F116: No liveness claim: no product promise says a missing day is eventually filled; filling is bounded per chart load (90 days, 10 s) and resumes on the next load, so progress depends on readers opening the chart, which no fairness assumption can honestly cover.
facts.F117: Second stressor walkthrough (not executed, design reading): blackout periods and the forecast filter reach the share through the same cycle-time population as Cycle Time Percentiles, so both widgets agree; a named Cycle Time selected on Cycle Time Percentiles does not change Within SLE (default Cycle Time only, scope); a demo load firing a refresh on partial data rewrites only today, which the next refresh corrects; a Portfolio with no closed Deliveries gives TooFew(0), not NoSle; the RetentionEdge guard makes a day reaching past retained items read empty so it is not filled as a false 0 share.
facts.F118: Usage-data event: not decided here; asked in the DEVOPS wave (Open, owner Product).
facts.F119: Context map: Flow metrics only. New glossary terms for ADR-270 Flow metrics: share within the SLE (of the Work Items closed in a window, the part whose Cycle Time is at or below the SLE days) and SLE in force on a day (the SLE stored with each daily record row). New concept: the Within SLE daily record (a fourth day-keyed snapshot table). No domain event published; reacts to TeamDataRefreshed and PortfolioFeaturesRefreshed. UI surfaces: the unit Metrics tab, Flow Overview and Predictability, unchanged. ADR-270 and ARCHITECTURE.md section 4 are updated in S7, where the table lands (Proposed -> confirmed).

facts.F120: Slice split confirmed as proposed: S5 is the walking skeleton (real closed Work Items and the owner real SLE through the running app); S6 carries the four verdict states; S7 carries the chart own too-few, no-SLE and no-history states; S8 the fill-in. Named Cycle Times out (confirmed). Between S5 and S6 nothing is pushed (AFK: nothing pushed until the maintainer says so), so the S5 body for NoSle/TooFew is never released alone.
facts.F121: Minimum closed Work Items for a verdict or a chart point: 5 (Q5); fewer gives TooFew with the count. Bound applies to the selected range (widget) and to each day trailing window (chart).
facts.F122: Status thresholds (Q7): Sustain when share >= target; Observe when below by up to and including 20 points; Act when more than 20 points below or no SLE set (Q10).
facts.F123: Horizons: exactly 30, 60, 90 trailing days (Q3); no other horizon is stored or served.
facts.F124: SLE inputs as validated today: probability (percentile) and range (days) are integers; an SLE exists only when both are greater than 0. No upper bound on days is introduced; percentile is 1..100 as the settings already accept. No narrower or wider bound is designed.
facts.F125: Date range: no maximum length is imposed on the widget range or the chart window (as siblings); the chart fill is bounded by the existing filler budget, 90 days and 10 s per pass.
facts.F126: Counts: 0 <= WithinCount <= ClosedCount; no upper bound on ClosedCount.
